systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Dense-Phase Supercritical CO2 Micro-Fluidic Hydrogel Bead Solidification & Core-Shell Bioactive Delivery (scCO2-MHB) Industrial Plant
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Non-Thermal Supercritical Micro-Fluidic Sol-Gel Solidification & Targeted Delivery Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 184.1724 Alginate / USP <711> Dissolution / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Fluid Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Coaxial Capillary Flow-Focusing Micro-Fluidic Nozzle Array coupled with In-Line Dense-Phase Supercritical CO2 (scCO2, P = 80 – 180 bar, T = 35 – 45°C) Dynamic In-Situ Carbonic Acid Acidification & Internal Calcium Ionic Gelation Chamber (monodisperse core-shell hydrogel micro-beads d = 10 – 80 µm, PDI < 0.045, encapsulation efficiency > 97.5%, targeted colon delivery > 98.2% resisting gastric simulated fluid pH 1.2 without organic solvents or thermal degradation)
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% PAA at 50°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Live Probiotic Bio-Active Matrix (Bifidobacterium infantis & Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Live probiotic bacterial cultures suspended in prebiotic fructooligosaccharide (FOS) aqueous core with sodium alginate-chitosan protective shell.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Bifidobacterium infantis (1.2 × 10¹¹ CFU/mL) + Inulin / FOS Prebiotic Matrix
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: High-Guluronate Sodium Alginate (2.2% w/v) + Low-Molecular-Weight Chitosan (0.6% w/v) + Nano-CaCO3 (0.35% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot Air Spray Drying (160°C inlet, >3.8 log CFU thermal kill, severe cellular membrane rupture)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP, USP <711> Enteric Dissolution & GRAS Notice GRN 000572

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Lipophilic Curcuminoid Nano-Crystalline Core-Shell Complex (Curcuma longa)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Standardized 95% total curcuminoid extract pre-homogenized in medium-chain triglyceride (MCT) lipid core encapsulated in alginate-chitosan hydrogel matrix.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Curcuminoids (95% purity: Curcumin, DMC, BDMC) in Organic Cold-Pressed Coconut MCT Oil (25% w/w)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Sodium Alginate (2.5% w/v) + Depolymerized Chitosan (0.75% w/v) + Insoluble Dicalcium Phosphate (0.4% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Organic Solvent Emulsification-Evaporation (Dichloromethane / Acetone residues, solvent toxicity risk)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Curcumin Monograph, EFSA Novel Food & FDA 21 CFR § 73.600

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Wild Bilberry Anthocyanin Flavonoid Complex (Vaccinium myrtillus)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Water-soluble high-potency delphinidin, cyanidin, and petunidin glucosides vulnerable to gastric degradation and intestinal alkaline fading.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Purified 36% Anthocyanoside Aqueous Bilberry Extract + Ascorbic Acid Oxygen Scavenger
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Calcium-Crosslinked Alginate (2.0% w/v) + Crosslinked Carboxymethyl Cellulose (0.5% w/v) + Nano-CaHPO4 (0.3% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Thermal Evaporative Encapsulation (Thermally induces chalcone cleavage, loss of red anthocyanin hue)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: European Pharmacopoeia (Ph. Eur.) Bilberry Monograph & FDA 21 CFR § 117

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Microalgal DHA Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid Ester Core (Schizochytrium sp.)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: High-purity docosahexaenoic acid (45% DHA triglyceride) sensitive to lipid autoxidation, rancidity, and fishy regurgitation odor.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Schizochytrium Microalgal DHA Oil + Mixed Tocopherols Antioxidant (0.2% w/w)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Low-Viscosity High-M Alginate (1.8% w/v) + Whey Protein Isolate Shell Barrier (1.2% w/v) + Nano-CaCO3 (0.3% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Shear Fluid Bed Wax Coating (Incomplete gastric barrier, prone to oxidative rancidity during storage)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000553 & Codex Standard for Fish/Algal Oils (CXS 329-2017)

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Native Bovine Colostrum Lactoferrin Immunoglobulin Complex
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Bioactive iron-binding antibacterial glycoprotein easily denatured by gastric pepsin digestion and thermal processing.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Purified Native Bovine Lactoferrin (96% purity, iron-saturated holo-form 20%) in Isotonic Buffer
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Sodium Alginate (2.4% w/v) + Pectin Complex (0.8% w/v) + Nano-CaHPO4 (0.4% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Pan-Coating Glazing / Thermal Fluid Bed (Denatures tertiary protein folding, complete loss of lactoferrin bioactivity)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000465 & EFSA Lactoferrin Novel Food Opinion
